issueDefinitions.scope: Target-language grammar problems observable in the quoted learner text, such as word order, agreement, tense, or missing function words.
issueDefinitions.explanationRequirement: Name the grammar problem visible in the quote and give a corrected target-language version of the quoted span.

issueDefinitions.scope: Phrasing in the quoted learner text that a fluent speaker would find awkward or unidiomatic in the practice scenario, even when it is grammatical.
issueDefinitions.explanationRequirement: Explain why the quoted phrasing sounds unnatural and give a more natural target-language alternative for the quoted span.

issueDefinitions.scope: Ways the quoted learner text falls short of the step prompt or the material communication objective, such as a missing or off-topic answer.
issueDefinitions.explanationRequirement: State which required part of the step prompt or communication objective the quoted text does not fulfill and what is missing.
